title: CDS Maths
summary: CDS Mathematics past questions, CDS 2 2016 to CDS 2 2026, five a day. Questions UPSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question. A set of linked items counts as one question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 21 papers, CDS 2 2016 to CDS 2 2026. UPSC rarely reprints a question word for word, so most of the order comes from question types. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_CDS.md) and checked in the main session.
